paper_title: Mastering Chess and Shogi by Self-Play with a General Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
lecture_relevance: Provides the canonical AlphaZero recipe that the lecture ports into theorem proving.
Used as evidence that Alpha-style search+RL can reach algorithm discovery, not only board games.
Complements AlphaProof on IMO geometry tasks and highlights domain-specific formalization gaps.
Motivates the broader Lean ecosystem and educational formalization push behind AlphaProof.
